about: Real price comparisons for the Inflationsbeichte (App\Support\Caster\Programme\RoastMaterial, plan "TWENTY ONE Radio", P10). Every figure is copied from its source, checked 2026-10-12: the Oktoberfest prices from the City of Munich's open data (CSV), the postage from German Wikipedia. Prices before 2002 are in euros as the source gives them (converted from D-Mark by the source). No Döner or cinema ticket: no official series was found (searched: Wikipedia API, opendata.muenchen.de), and an unsourced price is not aired.
